in_sanskrit.name: भुबन
in_sanskrit.meaning: भु: to live, dwell | बन: to build
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who dwells and builds, or the one who builds a dwelling.

in_hindi.name: भुबन
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who dwells and builds, or the one who builds a dwelling.

in_tamil.name: புபன்
in_tamil.meaning: பு: உட்படுத்தல் (to build) | னன்: வீரம் (dwelling, abode)
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who builds a dwelling or the one who builds and dwells.

in_telugu.name: భుబన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who builds a dwelling or the one who dwells and builds.

in_marathi.name: Bhuban
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhuban हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhuban is a Sanskrit name derived from the root Bhuh, which means 'earth'. The name Bhuban signifies the lord or ruler of the earth. It is a name with deep spiritual roots and is commonly used in Hindu mythology.
